title: Ask my notes a question
blurb: Put your text files in a folder, ask a question in plain words, and get back the parts that answer it.
best_for: Meeting notes, study notes, a pile of recipes, research you keep in text files.

asks.label: What is this collection called?
asks.help: Only you see this: it is the name of the folder and the browser tab.

asks.label: Drop in your .txt or .md files (you can add more any time)

changing: To add more notes, drop .txt or .md files into the notes folder and refresh the page. It re-reads the folder every time.
Your notes are never changed or moved. This app only reads them.
The colour is the first line of web/style.css.
If a file is a PDF or a Word document, open it, select all the text, copy it, paste it into Notepad or TextEdit, and save it as a .txt file in the notes folder.

map.run.bat: double-click to start it on Windows
map.run.sh: double-click to start it on macOS or Linux
map.start.py: the search itself - about 200 lines, and commented
map.serve.py: the engine (you never need to open this)
map.web/index.html: the page you type your question into
map.notes/: your text files - add and remove them freely
